cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll play this chess game for a proper stake: the loser cooks all weekend. You can make the first move once we agree.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were playing for a biscuit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it beside the board as a reminder of how little we used to risk. This result should decide more than who gets a snack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I work both days this weekend. I couldn't cook even if I lost.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll allow weeknights instead. Five dinners, whoever loses. We'll remember every move while eating them. Accept that and open; I'll put my whole menu at risk too.
